work.heading: What I've built
work.intro: Most of this is employer or client work, so the code is private. I'm glad to walk through any of it on a call.
work.scProblem: An unattended retail cooler has to know which products each customer takes, with no cashier.
work.scB1: Two-stage detection and classification running on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, optimized with TensorRT FP16.
work.scB2: Multi-object tracking at 60 fps, with automatic camera recalibration through SIFT homography.
work.scB3: The evaluation harness (leave-one-day-out validation, pre-registered thresholds) that set the production frame-rate and image-format requirements.
work.fisioProblem: Physiotherapy clinics need one place for patient records, appointments, treatment packages and payments, with each clinic's data kept apart.
work.fisioB1: Multi-tenant Next.js application on PostgreSQL covering clinical records, scheduling, packages and payments.
work.fisioB3: Self-hosted on the studio's own infrastructure behind Cloudflare Tunnels, with automated off-site backups to Backblaze B2.
work.feriuDesc: Multi-tenant, self-hosted shared-expense platform with a Splitwise-style settlement engine, built as a NestJS + Next.js pnpm monorepo on PostgreSQL.
work.karaokeDesc: Real-time karaoke request platform for live events: an SSE-synced queue, admin panel, self-serve kiosk mode and Virtual DJ integration. Express + React monorepo.
work.earlier: Earlier work: Galaga For Everyone, an Unreal Engine game played with a phone's accelerometer, and Stable Diffusion fine-tuning on a custom dataset.

experience.heading: Where I've worked
experience.monetaSummary: Designed and built the company's production platform (six services on AWS, the database behind it and an on-device vision pipeline) and led the team's two interns after the lead developer left.
experience.monetaB1: Replaced manual deployments with the company's first containerized platform: six services on AWS EC2 (two FastAPI microservices, Label Studio, MLflow, Nginx) brought up reproducibly with Docker Compose.
experience.monetaB7: Built an on-device computer-vision pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano that identifies the products a customer takes from a retail cooler, plus the evaluation harness that set its production requirements.
experience.monetaB2: Designed the PostgreSQL schema the operation runs on: 25 tables on AWS RDS with 24 foreign keys, 34 indexes, idempotent migrations and a soft-delete audit trail, reachable only through an SSH bastion.
experience.monetaB3: Built an event-driven FastAPI webhook service between Label Studio and S3 that keeps the two consistent when a step fails: atomic rollback across database and S3, async connection pooling, a cache with database fallback. Wrote the runbooks to operate it.
experience.monetaB4: Moved the frame-review desktop app off Windows-only WPF to cross-platform C# (.NET 10, Avalonia): MVVM, two-pass verification and a sliding-window prefetch cache.
experience.monetaB5: Locked down access with least-privilege IAM, AWS Secrets Manager and LocalStack, so development never touches production credentials; set up the CI pipelines.
experience.monetaB6: Built the data pipeline's operator tooling (CLIs, idempotent S3-to-PostgreSQL sync, drift audits) and automated model training in GitLab CI on ephemeral AWS GPU instances, tracked in MLflow.
experience.contractorNote: Side project, alongside my full-time role
experience.contractorSummary: Co-founded a studio that designs, builds and hosts web products for clients; three of them run in production today.
experience.contractorB2: Shipped three products that still run for real clients: FisioApp (multi-tenant clinic management, audited against WCAG 2.1 AA), Feriu (multi-tenant shared expenses) and Karaoke Balu (real-time requests over SSE, kiosk mode).
experience.contractorB1: Deliver end to end on TypeScript pnpm monorepos: React and Next.js front ends, NestJS and Express APIs, PostgreSQL. Earlier projects shipped on React Native, FastAPI and Django.
experience.contractorB3: Host every client app on the studio's own infrastructure as a low-cost alternative to Vercel or AWS: Proxmox and Ubuntu Server, Dokploy and Docker Compose with health checks, Cloudflare Tunnels with no inbound ports open.
experience.rogaSummary: Kept the ERP of a retail group with 170+ branches running and growing, and designed new modules for it from scratch.
experience.rogaB1: Extended the ERP running 170+ branches and used by 1,750+ employees (Mueblería El Pasito, Villarreal Muebles, Dinexpress) across point of sale, multi-branch inventory, pricing and accounts receivable, in .NET Framework.
experience.rogaB2: Designed and built from scratch the module that manages field agents visiting customer homes for credit approval, with DevExpress maps plotting assignments and data from a companion Android app.
experience.rogaB3: Designed the SQL Server layer behind multi-branch operations (stored procedures for inventory aggregation and pricing, and HTML report emails composed with Chilkat), replacing manual report compilation.
